title: Cosmic House of Mirrors
caption:
The James Webb Space Telescope just revealed a cosmic funhouse. Massive galaxy clusters can act as giant lenses, bending and multiplying the light of distant galaxies behind them.

Source: Nasa - Cosmic House of Mirrors
